Who it's for

Built for Every Level of Aviation Education

From secondary school aviation programs to flight colleges and workforce development boards — AACP™ scales to your institution's needs.

School Boards & Secondary Schools

Introduce aviation careers to students early. Integrate AACP™ into career education programs, co-op placements, and skilled trades pathways.

Colleges & Universities

Support aviation program students with pathway clarity, scholarship discovery, and AI-guided career mentorship — integrated into your student services.

Flight Training Units (FTUs)

Help student pilots understand the full scope of aviation careers beyond the flight deck. Reduce dropout by aligning student goals to realistic pathways.

Workforce Development Programs

Use AACP™ for labour market intelligence, skills gap analysis, and guided reskilling pathways into aviation and aerospace roles.
